body.purpose: Table cells, form values, nav labels, default running text.

label.purpose: Field labels, table headers, sidebar group headings.

shadows.name: floating
shadows.purpose: Reserved for surfaces that float above content: the user menu dropdown, the mobile nav drawer.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single primary action per view (e.g. page-header "Add" action, form submit).
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #3F6F62; color: #FFFFFF; height: 40px; padding: 0 16px; border-radius: 8px; border: none; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; transition: background 0.15s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #345D52; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #3F6F62; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Default button for every non-primary action, including delete triggers (danger red is reserved for the confirmation step, not this resting state).
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: #FFFFFF; color: #202623; height: 40px; padding: 0 16px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid #DCE1DD; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; transition: background 0.15s; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #ECEFEB; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Standard single-line field used across every form in the admin.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; height: 40px; padding: 0 12px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid #DCE1DD; background: #FFFFFF; color: #202623; font-size: 14px; font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #929A96; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: #3F6F62; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #E1EBE7; } .ds-input:disabled { background: #ECEFEB; color: #929A96; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Status Badge
components.description: Compact status indicator for leads, orders, products, fulfillment type — light tint background, never a saturated fill.
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; border-radius: 999px; padding: 2px 10px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; background: #E5F1E9; color: #3F7658; }

components.name: Card
components.description: Resting container for forms, stat tiles, and grouped content. Flat, bordered, no shadow.

components.name: Sidebar Nav Item
components.description: The signature component: active state carries a 2px primary-green indicator bar, the one hard-edged color accent in the system.
components.css: .ds-nav-item { position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 8px 12px; border-radius: 8px; color: #929C97; font-size: 14px; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav-item:hover { background: #2B3732; color: #D8DEDA; } .ds-nav-item--active { background: #2B3732; color: #D8DEDA; font-weight: 500; } .ds-nav-indicator { position: absolute; left: -12px; top: 6px; bottom: 6px; width: 2px; border-radius: 999px; background: #3F6F62; }

narrative.overview: Phay Admin is being built as a white-label CRM product, not a single business's branded tool — the visual system has to work for any service company it gets relabeled for, so nothing in it is allowed to read as "AI-generated SaaS" or as one company's personality. It is an Operate-mode surface: an operator opens it for hours a day to scan leads, prices, and content, so clarity and low visual noise outrank expression. The system explicitly rejects the current-generation AI-app default — purple/blue gradients, neon glow, heavy glassmorphism, oversized rounded corners, loud status pills — in favor of a quieter instrument-panel language: a dark, informationally-neutral sidebar frames a warm, paper-light work surface, and a single muted green stands in for "this matters" wherever it appears.
keyCharacteristics: Warm light ground, not cold gray or pure white, so long sessions don't feel clinical.
One accent color, used sparingly, never decoratively.
Flat surfaces separated by hairline borders, not shadows.
Compact, information-dense tables and forms over card grids.
Status communicated by small, muted-background badges, never saturated color blocks.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: The primary green is reserved for primary actions, the active nav indicator, selected rows, and headline metrics. It never fills a whole card, a whole table row, or a decorative background.

rules.name: The Quiet Danger Rule
rules.body: Destructive actions (delete) render as a neutral secondary button by default; red is earned only inside an explicit confirmation step, never worn as a standing toolbar color.

rules.name: The Border-Not-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Resting surfaces (cards, tables, inputs) separate from the page with a 1px border. Shadow is reserved for things that float above content (menus, drawers), never for resting cards.

dos: Do keep every color, radius, and spacing value as a CSS custom property in admin/src/app/admin/admin.css, isolated from the public site's globals.css, so a tenant's brand color and a future dark theme can override them without touching component markup.
Do use the secondary button style for delete triggers; reserve solid danger-red for the moment inside a confirmation step.
Do use badges (light tint + semantic text color) for every status value, never a raw colored <span>.
Do render an unbuilt CRM module as a disabled, tagged sidebar row rather than omitting it or faking a working screen.
donts: Don't introduce gradients, glow, or glassmorphism anywhere in the admin — the brief explicitly refuses the "AI app" look.
Don't give cards or buttons large/pill radii; the system caps at 10px except true pill badges and tags.
Don't use pure black (#000) or the public site's teal-family tokens inside /admin — the two token systems are intentionally decoupled.
Don't stack shadows on resting surfaces; depth comes from a 1px border, not elevation.
